\begin{figure}[!tbp]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{../figures/out/rse_fig_study_area.pdf}
  \caption{\textbf{Study area.}
  (a)~The North Caspian study domain (thick black outline) and its seven reporting sectors (thin outlines).
  A sector is checked (bold name in a black box) when, in its ICESat-2 test blocks, the mean and the median errors of the waterline elevation model against ATL08 and against ATL06 all lie within $\pm\metric{params.checked_tol_m}$~m.
  The Volga delta and Komsomolets Bay fail this rule and the Ural delta has no test block; these three sectors are hatched, with names in italics.
  Vermilion squares: the \metric{h2.atl08.n_test_blocks} test blocks of \metric{h2.block_size_km}~km that hold ICESat-2 points.
  Tan: seabed that emerged between the \metric{params.highstand_label} high stand and the \metric{params.lowstand_label} low stand.
  Light blue: the open sea of the \metric{params.lowstand_label} low stand, from Landsat.
  Dash-dotted line: international boundary.
  (b)~The study domain (vermilion outline) in the Caspian region.}
  \label{fig:rse_study_area}
